HediffDef.label: wraith hybrid graft integration
HediffDef.description: A living Growth Chamber has attached an invasive Wraith-derived graft to this subject. The pawn is being kept conscious enough to survive while movement and manipulation are heavily suppressed during genomic integration.

HediffDef.label: unstable Wraith-human graft
HediffDef.description: This pawn survived forbidden Wraith-human hybridisation. Their identity and original biology remain recognisable beneath a permanent xenogene graft that supplies incomplete Wraith traits and recurring instability.

HediffDef.label: wraith-human instability flare
HediffDef.description: The human and Wraith-derived systems have fallen temporarily out of synchronisation. Neurological noise, metabolic rejection and unstable tissue signalling impair movement, manipulation and consciousness until the flare settles.
